addepar_group_updated_trigger.description: Runs when a group in Addepar changes, such as its name or members. Each change starts it once; changes made before the workflow was turned on don't. Addepar is checked every 15 minutes.

output.attributes: Its other attributes, by their API field name
output.child_group_ids: The IDs of the groups inside it
output.group_type: Its group type, such as GROUPS
output.member_ids: The entity IDs of its members
output.name: Its name

parameters.description: Only groups of this type. Leave blank for every type.
parameters.name: group_type

addepar_new_account_trigger.description: Runs when a holding account is added to Addepar, such as one a custodian's feed brings in, with its name, currency and attributes. Accounts already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. Addepar is checked every 15 minutes.

output.attributes: Its other attributes, by their API field name
output.display_name: The name shown in its place, if one is set
output.name: Its name as Addepar shows it: its display name, or its name
output.ownership_type: How it is owned: PERCENT_BASED, SHARE_BASED or VALUE_BASED; empty for a client
output.type: Its type, as Addepar stores it, such as PERSON_NODE
output.type_name: Its type as Addepar's app names it, such as Client

addepar_new_client_trigger.description: Runs when a client is added to Addepar, with their name and attributes. Clients already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. Addepar is checked every 15 minutes.

output.attributes: Its other attributes, by their API field name
output.display_name: The name shown in its place, if one is set
output.name: Its name as Addepar shows it: its display name, or its name
output.ownership_type: How it is owned: PERCENT_BASED, SHARE_BASED or VALUE_BASED; empty for a client
output.type: Its type, as Addepar stores it, such as PERSON_NODE
output.type_name: Its type as Addepar's app names it, such as Client

addepar_new_contact_trigger.description: Runs when a contact, someone who can be given the Client Portal, is added to Addepar, with their emails and phone numbers. Contacts already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. Addepar is checked every 15 minutes.

output.entity_ids: The entities they are affiliated with
output.external_user_id: Your firm's own ID for them
output.group_ids: The groups they are affiliated with
output.login_email: The email they sign in to the Client Portal with
output.name: Their full name
output.portal_access: Their Client Portal access, such as deactivated
output.title: Their title, such as Mr.

addepar_new_entity_trigger.description: Runs when an entity is added to Addepar, such as a trust, a household or an investment, or only one of the type you choose. Entities already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. Addepar is checked every 15 minutes.

output.attributes: Its other attributes, by their API field name
output.display_name: The name shown in its place, if one is set
output.name: Its name as Addepar shows it: its display name, or its name
output.ownership_type: How it is owned: PERCENT_BASED, SHARE_BASED or VALUE_BASED; empty for a client
output.type: Its type, as Addepar stores it, such as PERSON_NODE
output.type_name: Its type as Addepar's app names it, such as Client

parameters.description: Only entities of this type, such as Trust. Leave blank for every type.
parameters.name: entity_type

addepar_new_file_trigger.description: Runs when a file is added to Addepar's file vault, such as a report or a statement, in the whole firm or for one client. Files already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. Addepar is checked every 15 minutes.

output.content_type: What kind of file it is, such as application/PDF
output.entity_ids: The entities it is linked to
output.group_ids: The groups it is linked to
output.name: Its name, with its extension
output.parent_folder_id: The folder it is in; empty or 0 at the top

parameters.description: Only files linked to this client or other entity, by its ID. Leave blank for every file.
parameters.name: entity

addepar_new_group_trigger.description: Runs when a group, such as a household, is added to Addepar, with its members. Groups already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. Addepar is checked every 15 minutes.

output.attributes: Its other attributes, by their API field name
output.child_group_ids: The IDs of the groups inside it
output.group_type: Its group type, such as GROUPS
output.member_ids: The entity IDs of its members
output.name: Its name

parameters.description: Only groups of this type. Leave blank for every type.
parameters.name: group_type

addepar_new_transaction_trigger.description: Runs when a transaction is added to Addepar, in the whole firm or one client or account, with its type, trade date, value and who holds it. Transactions already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. Addepar is checked every 15 minutes.

output.created_date: The day it was added to Addepar
output.owner_name: The entity that directly holds it, such as an account
output.posted_date: The day the custodian reported it
output.type: Its type, as the query gives it
output.units: How many shares or units; 0 if not set

parameters.description: Only transactions in this client, account or other entity, by its ID. Leave blank for the whole firm.
parameters.name: portfolio
